content.description:
Weave is the all-in-one customer communication and engagement platform for SMB-to-Enterprise healthcare practices. We build modern tools that elevate the patient experience through a unified platform that improves business operations so healthcare professionals can focus on patient care and realize their dreams.

As a Senior Product Designer, you will lead experiences across the full product lifecycle—from discovery and research through system architecture, execution, and iteration. We value designers who bring clarity to ambiguous spaces, pair deep craft with a systems mindset, and advocate relentlessly for customer needs. You will partner in a tight triad with Product and Engineering, reporting to a Product Design Manager who trusts your judgment and will make room for you to use it.

- This position is remote (India)

- Reports to: Product Design Manager, Product Design

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

The duties and responsibilities of the role.

- Design end-to-end workflows and edge states: Own core B2B experiences—from communication routing and task management to complex data collection—accounting for empty, error, and recovery states so customers succeed without contacting support.

- Establish scalable interaction models: Build flexible interaction patterns and primitives that balance depth with usability across varied customer workflows, contributing reusable patterns back to Weave’s design system.

- Drive triad alignment and roadmap influence: Partner daily with Product and Engineering to frame ambiguous problems, translate user needs into scoped plans, and ensure design intent and interaction quality hold true through delivery.

- Ground decisions in qualitative and quantitative evidence: Conduct research with practice owners and office staff, pair findings with telemetry from Pendo and Sigma, and use data to guide the team toward high-impact opportunities.

- Notice connections early: Identify where your domain overlaps with adjacent product teams before anyone ships, maintaining cross-platform cohesion and preventing siloed customer experiences.

- Elevate the design practice: Champion design quality through active critique, systems thinking, clear engineering documentation, and mentorship across the broader design organization.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO ACCOMPLISH THE JOB

The minimum qualifications for the role - education, experience, certifications, skills.

- Relevant Experience: You have 5+ years designing software products, including meaningful time on B2B or complex workflow surfaces.

- Demonstrated Process: You can walk us through one or two case studies that trace your thinking from problem framing through end-to-end user flows and interactions—not just final screens or static states.

- Systems Mindset: You design complex, multi-step flows and consider edge, error, and empty states as foundational to the work rather than an afterthought.

- Strategic Autonomy: You independently identify problems, balance technical constraints with customer needs, and actively inform product strategy alongside your Product and Engineering partners.

- Craft & Execution: You hold a high bar for craft, combining deep comfort in research methods and Figma (components, variants, prototyping) with a strict attention to accessibility, usability, and cross-platform consistency.

- Clear Communication: You explain your design thinking clearly in writing and in conversation, easily building alignment with engineers, cross-functional partners, and leadership.

WHAT WILL MAKE US LOVE YOU

Preferred qualifications - including personality traits and soft skills.

- You've designed communication, productivity, or business management products, and you enjoy talking about what made them hard.

- You've contributed components or patterns to a design system other teams relied on, and you know when to deviate from one.

- You've worked in healthcare, dental, veterinary, or another regulated industry and understand what compliance does to a user flow.

- You've run user interviews and used product analytics (Pendo, Sigma, Domo, or equivalent) to inform your decisions.

- Ambiguity is interesting to you. The problem arrives as a vague customer pain point and you help turn it into a scoped, sequenced plan.

- You're at ease as the only designer on a team, and you bring people along rather than working around them.

- You share work before it's finished and would rather be corrected early than praised late.

- You care deeply about designing valuable user and customer experiences.

Employment with Weave is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, conducted in accordance with applicable laws.

At Weave, we use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to help us work more efficiently and create a smoother candidate experience. AI may assist with things like writing job descriptions, scheduling interviews, or reviewing applications against job-related criteria. For additional information, please review the External AI Policy Statement available on our Careers page.

Weave is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and supported. We welcome anyone who is hungry to learn, problem-solve and progress regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Beware of recruitment fraud. All official correspondence will occur through Weave branded email. We will never ask you to share bank account information, cash a check from us, or purchase software or equipment as part of your interview or hiring process.
